title: AGA — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for AGA.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Heritage Cast Iron." Premium tier. AGA has been making cast iron ranges in England since 1922 — originally designed by a blind Nobel Prize winner. The AGA cooker stores heat in cast iron and radiates it gently, creating a unique cooking experience. Now part of Middleby Corporation. A lifestyle brand as much as an appliance.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: English country kitchen enthusiasts. Heritage home builds. Customers who want a truly unique cooking experience.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for AGA:

• Cast iron cooking experience unlike any other appliance

• English heritage since 1922 — a genuine lifestyle brand

• Radiant heat cooking produces unique flavors and textures

• Available in 14+ iconic colors

• The heart of the English country kitchen
